key_recommendations.recommendation: Metformin is preferred initial pharmacotherapy. In patients with established ASCVD, Heart Failure, or CKD, SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 RAs should be initiated independently of HbA1c.
Target HbA1c < 7.0% for non-pregnant adults without severe hypoglycemia. De-intensify regimen if recurrent hypoglycemia occurs.

guidelines.guideline_title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of CKD

key_recommendations.indication: Chronic Kidney Disease Stage 1-4 with Albuminuria
key_recommendations.recommendation: First-line therapy includes an ACE inhibitor or ARB titrated to maximum tolerated dose, plus an SGLT2 inhibitor for eGFR >= 20 mL/min/1.73m².
Discontinue Metformin if eGFR < 30 mL/min. Initiate nephrology referral for vascular access planning and renal replacement modality counseling.

guidelines.guideline_title: GINA Global Strategy for Asthma Management and Prevention 2023

key_recommendations.recommendation: Low-dose ICS-formoterol is the preferred reliever across all asthma steps. SABA-only treatment without ICS is no longer recommended due to increased severe exacerbation risk.

guidelines.organization: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE)
guidelines.guideline_title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management [NG136]

key_recommendations.recommendation: Offer an ACE inhibitor or ARB for adults aged < 55 or with type 2 diabetes. Offer a CCB for adults aged >= 55 or of Black African/Caribbean family origin.
